scriptLines: derivedColumn1 derive(admission_date = case(   regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{1,2}, [0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM d, yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(concat(substring(trim(admission_date), 1, 6),                   iif(toInteger(substring(trim(admission_date), 7, 2)) > 26, '19', '20'),                   substring(trim(admission_date), 7, 2)), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   toDate(null()) ),

discharge_date = case(   regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{1,2}, [0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM d, yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),     toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),     toDate(concat(substring(trim(discharge_date), 1, 6),                   iif(toInteger(substring(trim(discharge_date), 7, 2)) > 26, '19', '20'),                   substring(trim(discharge_date), 7, 2)), 'MM-dd-yyyy'),   toDate(null()) )) ~> derivedColumn2

derivedColumn2 derive(department = case(                     dept_key == 'generalsurgery' || dept_key == 'gensurg', 'General Surgery',                     dept_key == 'neurology' || dept_key == 'neuro' || dept_key == 'nuerology', 'Neurology',                     dept_key == 'cardiology' || dept_key == 'cardio' || dept_key == 'cardiolgy', 'Cardiology',                     dept_key == 'orthopedics' || dept_key == 'orthopaedics' || dept_key == 'ortho', 'Orthopedics',                     dept_key == 'emergency' || dept_key == 'emergancy' || dept_key == 'er', 'Emergency',                     dept_key == 'pediatrics' || dept_key == 'paediatrics' || dept_key == 'peds', 'Pediatrics',                     dept_key == 'oncology' || dept_key == 'onco' || dept_key == 'oncologyy', 'Oncology',                     toString(null())),

discharge_date = iif(!isNull(discharge_date) && !isNull(admission_date)                        && discharge_date < admission_date,                      toDate(null()), discharge_date)) ~> derivedColumn3
